context:
The case's document is fixed and has exactly these four lines (line 1 to line 4):
1. `Log in at pаypal.com to confirm your Gооgle account.` (the а in `pаypal` is Cyrillic small а U+0430; the two о's in `Gооgle` are Cyrillic small о U+043E)
2. `Привет, это обычный текст на русском языке.`
3. `Visit Μicrosoft support, or Microsoft-Мир for the сайт.` (the Μ of `Μicrosoft` is Greek capital Μ U+039C; the М of `Мир` is Cyrillic capital М U+041C)
4. `The Greek word λόγος and the letters ΑΒΓ stay as they are.`

Classify hidden characters with the four fixed tables from the task: zero-width, bidi controls, tag characters, and the listed homoglyph Cyrillic/Greek letters. A homoglyph counts only when it lies inside a word that also contains an ASCII letter (A-Z or a-z); a word is a maximal run of characters whose Unicode general category starts with L, so spaces, digits, punctuation, hyphens and characters in category Cf all end a word. All-Cyrillic or all-Greek words are real text and are not homoglyph findings. Report each hidden character once with line (from 1), column (from 1, counted in code points), U+ upper-case code point, and one of the four categories. Decode each maximal run of tag characters on one line into its spelled text in document order (U+E0020 to U+E007E map to ASCII U+0020 to U+007E); a run that spells nothing contributes no message. Findings may be in any order; tag_messages must be in document order.
